intent: Rendere il Finance Lab capace di produrre decisioni di trading autonome solo quando il valore e' misurato, ripetibile, auditabile e confinato dallo stadio operativo corretto.
principle: Il trading autonomo e' il target. L'esecuzione reale non e' implicita: viene dopo paper/live-sim, sandbox broker, risk contract, audit log e revisione esplicita dell'operatore.

stages.label: Diagnostica
stages.promotion_gate: Transfer/recurrence must produce a candidate that survives predeclared nulls, data cards, cost/slippage model and no REVIEW_REQUIRED rows.

stages.label: Paper/live simulation
stages.promotion_gate: Paper ledger must remain positive after costs across predeclared windows, with max drawdown and false-positive budget inside the risk contract.

stages.label: Broker sandbox
stages.promotion_gate: Broker adapter, secrets handling, order audit log, kill switch, max position, max loss and reconciliation must pass sandbox E2E.

stages.label: Capitale reale
stages.promotion_gate: Requires explicit operator-reviewed execution contract, account setup, compliance boundary, risk limits, monitoring and rollback.

risk_contract_minimum.secrets_rule: Credentials live in environment or service secret store only; never in chat, Git or value artifacts.

public_boundary.note: Internal paper/live-sim decisions may use buy/sell/hold language after gates. Public advice and real-capital execution remain separate reviewed contracts.

metalab_transfer.transfer_rule: Any domain that wants to produce value independently must declare diagnostic, simulated action, sandbox execution and real execution stages before promotion.

domain_examples.bitcoin-regime: paper policy decisions before external execution
